pairs.subject: entity-lifecycle
pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/palette/PreviewEntities.tsx:109 An archived JD reached through recents renders without an archived indicator because loadJd preserves archived rows but the preview contract and renderer omit their archive state.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/palette-preview/types.ts:130 The JD preview cannot communicate archival: resolveJd calls loadJd, which returns archived_at, but discards it; PreviewJd renders no archived indicator, violating the clearly archived surface requirement.
app/features/shell/palette/usePalettePreview.ts:73 This fetch obtains navigation facts; the pane neither previews destruction nor requests destructive consent.
app/features/shell/palette/previewCache.ts:63 Clearing this in-memory preview memo destroys no domain entities; there is no entity purge operation here.
app/features/shell/palette/usePalettePreview.ts:99 Retry removes a local fetch result so it can reload; it does not delete an entity or determine dependent-record fates.
app/api/palette/preview/route.ts:29 The backing endpoint returns resolved facts without performing a lifecycle transition requiring a transition record.
app/features/shell/palette/previewCache.ts:48 Expired preview entries are evicted during reads; this context does not perform cross-store entity deletion or dispatch reapers.
app/features/shell/palette/PreviewEntities.tsx:136 The renderer displays a supplied nullable source identifier and creates no historical record whose provenance must be captured.
